# Explore a reproducible data space

This reference lesson demonstrates the R-LearnXR MVP. The analysis remains ordinary R code, while the 3D scene provides an optional spatial view of the same points.

```{r}
#| echo: true
source("../../R/utils.R")
source("../../R/zzz.R")
source("../../R/render_scene.R")

demo <- read.csv("data/learning_points.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
set.seed(2026)
render_scene(
  demo,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  z = "z",
  labels = demo$label,
  output_dir = "scene",
  title = "R-LearnXR reference data space",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
summary(demo[, c("x", "y", "z")])
```

[Open the interactive 3D scene](scene/index.html)

The scene is browser-based and does not require a headset. A future version may expose WebXR when a compatible device is available.
